preparation.name: half_mixed
preparation.construction: independent local bits with supplied occupation probabilities; all initial coherences/current zero

assessment.interpretation: finite-node mean window; descriptive sampling check, not simultaneous confidence or permanent settling

mean_forward_validation.interpretation: classical constant-final-step continuation; sampling checked only at output

uncertainty.note: product mixtures are analytically averaged per path; preparation-bit and measurement shot noise are not sampled; R=1 SE is a zero placeholder

workload.note: optional depth model = local preparation layer + supplied per-step cost; no compilation performed

covariance_gauge: physical C_ij = (-i)^i i^j M_ij; C_ij = <c_j^dagger c_i>
